name: Panda Mask II
caption: A Japanese técnico trained by the original Panda Mask who lost the triangular match of FMLL I when a referee missed his arm under the rope.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-06-07 to 2009-07-16.

name: El Hijo del Esperanzo
caption: The 19-year-old son of a retired lucha legend, in a metallic green and white mask, beaten with Aqua Caliente by Rey Amante and Arcángel IV in the FMLL I semi-final.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-06-07 to 2009-07-16.

name: Jeff Davis
caption: An American flag-waving rudo, a former security guard who resents Mexico and captained the six-man side opposite Las Tres Estrellas de Galáctico.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-06-09 to 2009-07-24.

name: El Hijo del Rey
caption: The 5th-year técnico son of a lucha legend buried in his mask, captain of Las Tres Estrellas de Galáctico.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-06-09 to 2009-06-30.

name: Checkmate
caption: A rook-masked member of Las Tres Estrellas de Galáctico.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-06-09 to 2009-07-16.

name: Carlos Correjo
caption: A black-mulleted, mustached member of Las Tres Estrellas de Galáctico.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-06-09 to 2009-07-16.

name: Arcángel IV
caption: A rudo of a famous wrestling family, in a grey moth mask, who with Rey Amante took the FMLL I semi-final in two falls.

entrance_music.title: Again We Rise
entrance_music.verbatim: "Again We Rise" by Lamb of God

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-06-09 to 2009-07-24.

name: Aqua Caliente
caption: A técnico formerly billed Cazador de Tornado, from a family of luchadores in Rosarita, who lost the FMLL I semi-final with El Hijo del Esperanzo to Rey Amante and Arcángel IV.

entrance_music.title: Let's Get It Started
entrance_music.verbatim: "Let's Get It Started" by the Black Eyed Peas

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-06-12 to 2009-07-16.

name: Rey Amante
caption: El Presidente en los Pantalones, an American former adult-film performer turned rudo, who won the FMLL I semi-final with Arcángel IV.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-06-14 to 2009-07-24.

name: Diego en Fuego
caption: An American-born técnico in a flame mask who won the FMLL I triangular match in a controversial finish.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-06-17 to 2009-07-16.

name: Fanatic
caption: An aerialist rudo exiled from 'the Land of Fanatics', the third man in the FMLL I triangular match.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-06-20 to 2009-07-24.

A BattleBRAWL Rumble entrant (20 March 2011); challenged Mr. Entertainment for the New ERA Championship at PrimeTime (31 May 2011) and defended it against The First at Cyberstrike 12 (12 August 2011); still on the roster for Cyberstrike 14 (11 March 2015).

name: Kid Koala
caption: A relaxed Australian técnico, the loudest of the Marsupials of Mayhem, with a corkscrew-heavy aerial style.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-07-07 to 2009-08-12.
The Slamtrack 2 broadcast (11 September 2014) through the Slamtrack 8 broadcast (3 April 2015), both served under this wing.

name: Kid Nah
caption: A member of the Marsupials of Mayhem, booked with Kid Koala for FMLL II.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-07-07 to 2009-08-12.
The Slamtrack 2 broadcast (11 September 2014) and the Slamtrack 7 broadcast (1 March 2015), both served under this wing.

notes: RLW's Marsupials of Mayhem (2014 to 2015) are Kid Koala, eKid Nah and Kangarry Roo; this fed's Marsupials of Mayhem (2009) are Kid Koala, Kid Nah and Kanga Roo. The same trio name, leader and pun-names; presumed one character, beside the team's and Kid Koala's own rows.

name: Kanga Roo
caption: A member of the Marsupials of Mayhem, booked with Kid Koala for FMLL II.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-07-07 to 2009-08-12.
RLW's own house-roster listing (served, 6 August 2014) and the Slamtrack 2 broadcast (11 September 2014).

name: Poderoso
caption: A heavy luchador billed on the rudo-aligned six-man side of the FMLL I main event.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-06-20 to 2009-07-16.

name: Mariposa Guerrera
caption: A flamboyant luchador who consoled Diego en Fuego and was billed on the FMLL I main event.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-06-20 to 2009-07-16.

name: Rob Franklin
caption: A former non-champion jobber who recruits a masked student for the fed in a chicken-choking 'rite of passage'.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2009-06-15 to 2009-06-15.

identity.note: Same name as an EPW wrestler (November 2007; later billed Mister Sunshine); this fed's Rob Franklin is a self-described former jobber who recruits a masked student. The name is the only link.

name: Arturo Sandoval
caption: The staged owner of the FMLL, who in July 2009 formed a championship committee and announced Heavyweight, Light-Heavyweight and Middleweight titles.

caption: The play-by-play commentator of the fed's broadcasts.

caption: The rudo-loving color commentator of the fed's broadcasts.

caption: The studio host of the fed's Noti-FMLL news segment.

caption: The referee of FMLL I, whose slow counts favour the rudos and whose missed rope-break decided the triangular match.
